newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE appoints new head of Chechnya mission.
newsitem.headline: OSCE appoints new head of Chechnya mission.

text.p: The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) said on Thursday it had appointed Danish diplomat Rudolf Thorning-Petersen as the new head of its mission in Chechnya.
Thorning-Petersen will replace Swiss diplomat Tim Guldimann, who had held the post since January 1996.
Guldimann played a key role in the organisation and monitoring of democratic elections in the breakaway republic and in efforts to find a permanent peace settlement.

Chechnya's former provisional president Zelimkhan Yandarbiyev expelled Guldimann from the region for calling Chechnya part of the Russian Federation. Chechnya is seeking formal independence but Moscow refuses any concession on sovereignty.
The Vienna-based security forum seeks to prevent conflicts and ease tensions while promoting democracy, arms control and human rights in Europe.
